title: 万兽纪元觉醒式世界HUD原创图标包

authorization.usageScope: Beastbound Odyssey project runtime and derivative production under applicable OpenAI terms

referencePolicy.use: layout hierarchy, anchor density and material direction only
referencePolicy.statement: 外部主界面截图只用于理解成熟HUD层级与材质方向；本包未复制、裁切、描摹或嵌入参考游戏的像素、图标、角色、标志、商标、文字、红点或数值。

generationPolicy.method: OpenAI ImageGen original raster generation on green chroma-key background
generationPolicy.derivation: chroma-key removal, green edge cleanup, alpha-bound normalization, proportional resize and transparent-canvas centering

replacementPolicy.rule: 先替换同名source/generated源，再派生同名runtime/icons成品；保留用途和运行时路径，重新核对尺寸、Alpha、字节数与SHA-256并同步本清单。
replacementPolicy.ownerAcceptance: 新运行图在项目所有者观看冻结1x实机视频并明确通过前保持owner_review_pending。
